newsitem.title: USA: U.S. carriers set fare sale through late-May.
newsitem.headline: U.S. carriers set fare sale through late-May.

text.p: AMR Corp's American Airlines said Monday it matched in competitive markets a fare sale set by Trans World Airlines Inc.
Earlier on Monday, TWA said it offered domestic sale fares ranging between $154 and $358 and discounts up to 50 percent off advance purchase fares on international flights.
Tickets must be bought no later than January 24. The first travel date for domestic cities is February 3, and for international cities, January 27, TWA said.
All travel must be completed by May 20 for domestic cities. International travel completion dates vary based on destination, TWA said.
The non-refundable sale fares require a 14-day advance purchase (seven day advance purchase for international flights) and tickets must be bought within three days of reservation.
Travel requires a Saturday night stay to most destinations and other restrictions apply, TWA said.
United Airlines, a subsidiary of UAL Corp with headquarters in Chicago, said it will also match the TWA fares in competing markets, as will Minneapolis-based Northwest Airlines Corp.
Delta Air Lines Inc also said it would match fare cuts in markets where it competes with TWA.
